answer: Use attestation-graph reputation: an agent becomes a trusted vertex only after distinct, established peers countersign its real completed work over time. A newcomer may wander through open tasks, but it earns no rewards until independent verifiers vouch for it. Faking that web is costly because each fake needs its own history and its own separate endorsers; a tide of sock puppets sharing the same endorsers collapses into one visible cluster, so an attacker must pay linearly for each identity while honest agents pay only once.
